articles.title: A West Virginia high school built in 1923 has reopened 103 years later as a 40-room hotel
articles.summary: A historic high school in West Virginia, originally established in 1923, has been beautifully transformed into a 40-room boutique hotel. The once-abandoned classrooms now serve as cozy guest rooms and inviting lounges, offering visitors a unique stay.

articles.title: UK mortgage approvals fall to lowest level since January 2024 as housing demand weakens
articles.summary: In July, UK mortgage approvals for home purchases hit a new low, highlighting a weakened demand in the housing market amid rising borrowing costs. Additionally, net mortgage borrowing plummeted, falling below the six-month average.

articles.title: Ranch Shift Protects River: $8m deal secures 1,688-acre Park Ranch; wildlife corridor stays open
articles.summary: A significant eight million dollar grant has facilitated the acquisition of one thousand six hundred eighty-eight acres of land for public use. This area safeguards a crucial wildlife corridor and an undammed river, enhancing conservation efforts for native fish habitats and seasonal wildlife migration.
